items.title: Road Work · SH 2 Ngauranga Southbound Off-Ramp
items.detail: Due to various works, this off-ramp will be closed on Sunday 9th August and Monday 10th August nights between 9pm and 4:30am. Plan your journey accordingly, allowing extra time for travel.
